title: SMB Account Executive
description: <p>Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.<br><br>So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.<br><br>Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.</p> <h4><strong>The Role</strong></h4> <p>Square is looking for a team-oriented Account Executive that's excited to grow with us and make an impact on our UK business. Through your extraordinary communication skills, you will connect with customers to sell the value of Square to their business - quickly establishing trust and successfully building upon your relationships throughout the sales process. You're a great fit for this role if you've got an entrepreneurial spirit, a growth-oriented mindset and an innate knack for collaborative problem-solving.</p> <h4><strong>You Will</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Evaluate and introduce the value of Square to SMB merchants within the UK</li> <li>Oversee the sales cycle from prospecting to close</li> <li>Partner closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful onboarding for your customers</li> <li>Build a keen understanding of your pipeline and the necessary sales activities in order to achieve and exceed sales targets</li> <li>Demonstrate strong customer intuition and take a consultative approach to every conversation</li> <li>Partner with Product and Marketing teams to ensure Square is meeting the unique needs of the UK market</li> <li>Collaborate with your team to both replicate successes across the team and to identify opportunities for improvement that drive impact</li> <li>Utilize your prior sales experience to get off the ground running with a creative pipeline strategy</li> </ul> <h4><strong>You Have</strong></h4> <ul> <li>2 - 3 years of experience in a qualifying or prospecting role</li> <li>A BA/BS degree or relevant experience</li> <li>Experience or an interest in helping SMB sellers</li> <li>An understanding of the importance of value-selling</li> <li>A track record of exceeding sales targets</li> <li>A structured thought process with the ability to assess business opportunities and read prospective buyers</li> <li>The ability to gather support from internal experts and external partners to position Square against our competitors</li> <li>Genuine curiosity about people, business, and can inspire this passion in others</li> <li>Interest in seeking out and implementing feedback, and dedication to the improvement of your craft</li> <li>Tenacity and an ability to adapt to new situations quickly and think on your feet</li> <li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills that help you connect with customers by email and phone to establish trust and credibility</li> <li>The ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)</li> <li>A collaborative and team player mentality</li> <li>Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent</li> </ul> <p>We're working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. title: Strategic Account Director, Logistics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.</p></div><p><strong>The Opportunity at Altana</strong></p> <p>Altana AI is looking for a Strategic Account Director to own and accelerate two high-priority, under-developed go-to-market motions: large customs broker sales and channel/partnership activation for logistics service providers (LSPs). This role combines strategic account ownership with hands-on execution across demos, conference engagements, and cross-functional collaboration with the broader Growth team.<br><br>The ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in trade compliance, customs brokerage, or supply chain technology, with an established network among top-tier brokers and LSPs. They are equally comfortable running a complex enterprise sales cycle and stepping onto a conference panel to represent Altana’s platform vision.</p> <p><strong>You Will</strong></p> <ul> <li>Large Logistics Service Provider Sales <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end sales cycle for Top-25 Global Logistics Providers, from prospecting through close</li> <li>Develop and execute an account strategy targeting high-value customs brokerage firms, leveraging existing warm relationships.</li> <li>Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for large broker accounts, building multi-threaded executive relationships</li> <li>Partner with Sales Engineering and Product to tailor demonstrations and proof-of-value engagements to broker-specific workflows</li> </ul> </li> <li>Cross-Functional Growth Support <ul> <li>Deliver product demonstrations, executive briefings, and pitch presentations to prospects and partners</li> <li>Represent Altana at industry conferences, trade shows, and panel discussions as a subject-matter expert</li> <li>Collaborate across the Growth team to share market intelligence, refine messaging, and support pipeline development for adjacent segments</li> <li>Contribute to thought leadership content, case studies, and competitive positioning</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>You Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise sales, business development, or strategic partnerships experience in supply chain technology, trade compliance, or logistics SaaS</li> <li>Demonstrated success selling into or partnering with large customs brokers, freight forwarders, or logistics service providers</li> <li>Established relationships with multiple Top-25 Global Logistics Providers.</li> <li>Track record of building and scaling new go-to-market motions from early stage to repeatable revenue</li> <li>Strong executive presence with the ability to deliver compelling presentations and represent the company externally</li> <li>Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with deal sizes of $500K+</li> <li>Preferred: <ul> <li>Prior experience in a dual role spanning both direct sales and channel/partnership development</li> <li>Familiarity with AI/ML platforms, data-as-a-service business models, or supply chain visibility tools</li> <li>Background in leading or contributing to sales at a high-growth B2B startup</li> <li>Experience with customs brokerage operations, ACE/ABI systems, or trade compliance technology</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>This role is based in New York or London with hybrid work flexibility.</p> <p><strong>US Salary Range</strong>: $180,000 - $210,000 USD</p> <p><strong>UK Salary Range</strong>: £120,000 - £140,000 GBP</p> <p>The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position.  The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees.</p> <p>The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Our Values</strong></h3> <p>Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Trust:</strong> Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.</li> <li><strong>Resilience: </strong>In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.</li> <li><strong>Stewardship:</strong> We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.</li> <li><strong>Courage: </strong>Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.</li> </ul> <p>At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, in any situation.</p> <p><em>Offers related to employment at Altana will come from an Altana.ai email address. title: Senior Data Scientist - Product Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <ul> <li>The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Fin use data and insights to drive evidence based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data — both big and small — to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. If you get really excited about asking the right questions, exploring patterns in data and surfacing actionable insights that drive strategic decisions, then this role is for you.</li> <li>Data Scientists in RAD partner with teams across R&D to help Fin make sense of our users, our products and our business, using metrics and data. This role will enable you to drive key data projects that directly impact our customers and millions of end users who communicate via our messaging platform daily.</li> </ul> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <ul> <li>You’ll partner with product teams to help them identify important questions and answer those questions with data</li> <li>You’ll work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to develop key product success metrics, to set targets, to measure results and outcomes, and to size opportunities</li> <li>You’ll design, build and update end-to-end data pipelines, working closely with stakeholders to drive the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data sources and tables.</li> <li>You’ll partner closely with product researchers to build a holistic understanding of our customers, our products and our business.</li> <li>You’ll influence our product roadmap and product strategy through experimentation, exploratory analysis and quantitative research</li> <li>You’ll build and automate actionable models and dashboards</li> <li>You’ll craft data stories and share your findings and recommendations across R&D and the broader company</li> <li>You’ll drive and shape core RAD foundations and help us improve how the RAD org operates</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need? </h2> <ul> <li>5 + years experience working with data to solve problems and drive evidence-based decisions</li> <li>Excellent SQL skills and experience of  applying analytical and statistical approaches to problem solving</li> <li>Proven track record of initiating and delivering actionable analysis and insights that drives tangible impact with minimal supervision</li> <li>Excellent communication skills (technical and non-technical) and a focus on driving impact</li> <li>Strong growth mindset and sense of ownership. Innate passion and curiosity</li> <li>Experience with a scientific computing language (such as R or Python)</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus skills & attributes </h2> <ul> <li>Experience with BI/Visualization tools like Tableau, Superset and Looker</li> <li>Experience with data modeling and ETL pipelines</li> <li>Experience working with product teams</li> <li>Experience leveraging AI tools to boost efficiency and creativity across the data science workflow — from ideation and coding to analysis and communication</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.</p> <p>You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.</p> <p><strong>This is a step-up opportunity.</strong> We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.</p> <p><strong>Key tasks and accountabilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build and ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production</li> <li>Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation</li> <li>Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call</li> <li>Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured</li> <li>Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit</li> <li>Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture and design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity</li> <li>Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin</li> <li>Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Spread what works</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes</li> <li>Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Expertise</strong></p> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace</li> <li>Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows</li> <li>Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release</li> <li>Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails</li> <li>Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bias to action:</strong> ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong> connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value</li> <li><strong>Intellectually honest:</strong> kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator:</strong> explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person</li> <li><strong>Influences without authority:</strong> gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated</li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal title: Product Designer - London
description: As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations. At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them. What you'll be doing Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them. Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction. Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship. Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn. Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike. Who you'll work with The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback. Likely a good fit if you Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies. Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive. Have a portfolio that shows your latest work. Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests. Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new. Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control. Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers. Are fluent in Figma. Can work within a design system and contribute to it. Stronger still if you Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces. Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us. If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match. How we hire Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our London office, and a closing 30-minute conversation. The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work. title: Engineering Lead (Drivers & Delivery)
description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. You'll lead a team of engineers, shape the squad's technical strategy together with its Product Manager, and work closely with our operations teams. Your team's work moves the numbers that matter most for HIVED: delivery cost per parcel, delivery success and customer satisfaction. The problems are concrete and varied. How do we know which drivers are our best, and how do we make performance transparent enough to act on? How do we reliably collect high-fidelity telemetry from a mobile app on the road, at scale? Where is the best place to park to deliver a given street, and how do we learn that from data? And what do operators need to see in Mission Control, and when, to keep a live operation running smoothly? What You'll Be Doing 🚀 Shape and champion the technical strategy. Decide, together with the Product Manager and in close collaboration with operations, which technologies and tech products we bring to the domain, and translate squad goals into clear technical direction. Organise effective delivery. Own how the team plans, prioritises and ships, with a focus on meaningful business outcomes rather than technical output. Build a high-performing team. Hire, coach and manage engineers, and establish and maintaining a high bar for performance. Guide the architecture. Facilitate and champion the team's architecture vision across distributed backend systems, data pipelines, mobile and web. Stay hands-on. A track record of shaping technical strategy for a domain, and of facilitating architecture decisions within a team. The ability to translate ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact. Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, product, data and operations. Nice to Have ✨ Experience in logistics, mobility, fleet or workforce management, or marketplaces. Experience with telemetry, geospatial or high-volume event data. Experience with mobile apps for frontline workers, ideally React Native. Experience in a fast-scaling operational environment where software has a direct physical-world impact. Technologies We Use 💻 Python, Go, TypeScript React Native (driver app), React (Mission Control) AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript) GCP, BigQuery, Looker Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus GitHub, GitHub Actions Claude Code Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design Our interviewing process 🪜 Intro call with the hiring manager Live coding challenge solving a problem A take home case study, followed by a discussion On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture) Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not. 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. title: Senior People Advisor

Support People Advisors, ensuring consistent, high-quality advice and operational delivery across the employee lifecycle. Provide trusted advice on organisational change, leadership effectiveness, team health, engagement, performance and culture. Change Management & Engagement Diagnose and lead the People elements of change projects that improve business performance and align with strategic goals. Partner with leaders and managers to ensure change is understood, communicated effectively and embedded well. Support change initiatives including organisational design, redeployment, ways-of-working changes and team restructures, ensuring risks are identified and mitigated. Work with senior leaders on timely communication and engagement plans for upcoming change. Advise on performance, conduct, absence, grievance, disciplinary and change-related matters. Maintain a proactive focus on wellbeing risks, including mental health, and ensure inclusion and wellbeing principles are considered across the employee journey. Provide insight and support on reward processes, including benchmarking where required. Ensure people data, reward activity and related processes are accurate, well managed and compliant. Maintain awareness of GDPR, data protection requirements and relevant internal policies and procedures. Support a regulated business environment by balancing innovation, fairness, employee experience and appropriate governance. People Advisor Support & Operational Excellence Support People Advisors, providing direction, coaching and development. Oversee the quality and consistency of advice provided to managers and employees. Prioritise and allocate casework, ensuring effective workload management and timely resolution. Identify opportunities to improve people processes, guidance, templates and manager self-service. Ensure People activity is delivered consistently, accurately and in line with policy, employment law and company values. Manager capability improves, particularly in performance, engagement, change and employee relations. People risks and wellbeing themes are identified early and addressed pragmatically. People Advisors are well supported, effective and delivering high-quality advice. People data and insight are used to inform better decisions and improve outcomes. Why this role matters Strengthens the connection between business strategy and people priorities, helping leaders build effective teams and make better people decisions. Improves organisational effectiveness, manager capability and employee experience through consistent, high-quality People partnership. About you Proven experience as a People Advisor, ideally in a fast-paced, scaling, operational or customer-service-led environment. Experience partnering with senior leaders and managers through periods of change, transformation or organisational complexity. Strong employee relations expertise and a deep understanding of UK employment law and best practice. Commercially minded, delivery-focused and able to balance business priorities with fairness, empathy and sound judgement. Confident using people data and insight to diagnose issues, influence decisions and improve outcomes. Comfortable working with reporting, Excel and larger data sets. Able to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and coach leaders effectively. Experience managing, coaching or developing People Advisors or HR colleagues. Strong attention to detail, high standards of accuracy and a commitment to quality. Curious, pragmatic and able to translate complex people matters into clear, practical advice. CIPD qualified or able to demonstrate equivalent experience. Experience in a regulated financial services environment is essential, with a good understanding of SM&CR or similar regulatory expectations. description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role * Open to hiring in London, UK. Runway is scaling its Enterprise revenue organization with leaders who know how to build and scale high-performance teams. And, who can operate a revenue machine while keeping customer value in mind - leading our industry-based revenue pods responsible for both net-new ACV, NRR, and Renewal. This role is designed for the leader who wants to accelerate their CRO career trajectory. Someone who knows how to build and scale teams and leadership excellence from $100M to $500M+ organizations, operate in AI-native fluid environments, and have experience selling-to, expanding, and renewing with client operators from across a variety of ICPs (From operators in Marketing, HR, Operations, and Finance, to technologists in AI, IT Infrastructure, and Security). title: Collections Strategy Analyst
description: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the Role. This is a great opportunity to join Zilch’s Risk team in a role that helps shape an important part of the customer lifecycle. As Collections Strategy Analyst, you will support how Zilch manages customers in arrears, improves recovery outcomes, and balances performance with fair and effective customer treatment. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Collections Strategy, this role will be focused on using data to find opportunities, develop practical recommendations, and help deliver improvements across the full collections journey. You’ll work across early arrears, later-stage collections, external partner activity, and recoveries, building a strong understanding of what drives performance and where we can improve. While performance monitoring and analysis will be an important foundation of the role, the real opportunity is to turn insight into action. You’ll be encouraged to identify areas of opportunity, shape proposals, support execution, and contribute to the strategic thinking behind how we continue to improve collections performance. This role would suit someone with strong analytical skills, good SQL capability, and experience in Collections and/or consumer lending. The successful candidate will be proactive, commercially curious, and motivated by using data to influence decisions, improve outcomes, and help build a strong collections strategy in a fast-growing fintech. Key Responsibilities. Build an understanding of Zilch’s end-to-end collections lifecycle, including early arrears, later-stage collections, external partner activity, and recoveries. Use data and insight to identify opportunities to improve collections strategy, customer treatment, segmentation, allocation, and recovery outcomes. Develop practical recommendations and proposals, with guidance, to support improvements across the collections lifecycle. Monitor collections performance, including targets, trends, customer outcomes, and key metrics such as roll rates, cure rates, liquidation, recoveries, placements, and payment performance. Use SQL to extract, analyse, and summarise data to support collections insight, strategy development, and decision-making. Assist with segmentation and allocation analysis across delinquency stages, customer groups, DCAs, and Debt Purchasers. Support analysis of DCA and Debt Purchaser placement, performance, and outcomes. Help investigate performance movements, identifying potential drivers, risks, and areas for improvement. Track the impact of strategy changes, operational initiatives, and external partner performance. Work with Collections, Credit Risk, Operations, Data, and other stakeholders to turn analysis into practical proposals and next steps. Support ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and improve understanding of collections performance. What We’re Looking For. Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data. Exposure to collections, arrears management, recoveries, or credit risk analytics. Good SQL skills, with the ability to query, manipulate, and summarise data. Experience in, or a genuine interest in, Collections, Credit Risk, fintech, lending, or financial services. Ability to interpret analysis, identify opportunities, and explain findings clearly. A proactive mindset, with an interest in turning insight into practical strategy proposals and operational actions. Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with performance data, recurring analysis, and target tracking. Comfortable working with stakeholders across different teams. Awareness of fair customer outcomes and regulatory expectations in a collections environment. Curious, organised, and keen to learn about collections strategy in a fast-moving fintech environment. Desirable Experience. Experience with Looker or a similar BI/reporting tool. Understanding of BNPL, consumer credit, lending, or payments. Exposure to segmentation, customer treatment strategies, operational performance analysis, or contact strategy. title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel </strong>to<strong> </strong>lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical’s legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment where the questions are often genuinely unprecedented — the terms on which Ubuntu is distributed, copyleft at enterprise scale, and commercial models built with the world’s largest cloud and silicon providers. The role calls for breadth across commercial contracting, corporate governance, IP and compliance rather than depth in any one of them. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based in our office in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>At least five years of senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business — a company whose product is software or technology it licenses to others, rather than technology-related work inside a company that buys and integrates it.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team of 15-20 or more qualified lawyers, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Direct experience of public company governance — listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls — gained either as counsel inside a listed company or on a listing process.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO from preparation to admission.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><div> <h3>The Role</h3> Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.<br><br>We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.<br><br>As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.<br>You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.<br><br><strong>Y</strong><strong>our responsibilities will include:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.</li> <li>Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.</li> <li>Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.</li> <li>Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.</li> <li>Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.</li> <li>Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.</li> <li>Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.</li> <li>Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.</li> <li>Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.</li> <li>Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.</li> </ul> <div><strong>We expect you to have:</strong></div> systems and failure handling.</li> <li>A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.</li> <li>Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.</li> </ul> <div><br>We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.<br>Experience with hardware provisioning, <strong>bare metal infrastructure</strong>, <strong>GPU platforms</strong>, or large server fleets would be valuable.<br>Familiarity with <strong>Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform</strong> is also useful.<br><em>We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.</em></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.</p> <p>Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.</li> <li>Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.</li> <li>Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.</li> <li>Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.</li> <li>Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.</li> <li>Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.</li> <li>Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.</li> <li>Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or PyTorch internals.</li> <li>Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.</li> <li>Open-source description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our </span></span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Banking & Markets practice are looking for experienced Managers & Senior Managers</span></span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none"> to join the team.</span> </span></h2> <p>Banking and Markets are being reinvented. AI is transforming how institutions operate, customer and regulatory expectations are rising, and established players are under pressure to grow, modernise and perform at pace. Our team works alongside senior leaders at financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most - from unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining operating models, to harnessing AI, modernising technology and responding to rapidly changing markets.</p> <p>Our clients include global transaction, corporate and investment banks, leading high-street banks, building societies, growing digital banking providers and more. title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise
description: TL;DR – We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers to join the team and build Lovable for our Enterprise customers. Your time will be split between customer engagements and building our core product. Up to 40% of your time could be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers to solve their hardest technical problems. The rest you’ll spend back in the product team, building what you’ve learned in the field into the Lovable platform. It’s a unique opportunity to work on both sides of enterprise software and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. About the role Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both. You'll build the parts of Lovable that Enterprise level companies depend on: security, governance, admin controls, integrations with their existing systems, and performance at scale. Up to 40% of your time you’ll be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers on their hardest technical problems. The rest of the time you’ll be back in the product team, building what the field showed you. The aim of every rotation is to turn what one customer needs into something every customer can use. If you want to stay deeply hands-on, close to both real customer problems and the product that solves them, this is that role. Forward Deployed rotations may involve travel to customer sites. What you’ll do Build and ship core enterprise capabilities across Lovable’s frontend, backend and AI systems, and operate them in production Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems Spend up-to 40% of your time forward deployed with enterprise customers, solving their hardest technical problems Turn what you learned in the field into foundational platform improvements Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries Shape how the Enterprise team runs its field rotations, including engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations What we’re looking for 8+ years experience building, shipping and maintaining production-grade software Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including robust backend (Go, Rust) development and React and TypeScript on the frontend You have worked directly with customers, and have the product sense to tell a one-off request from something every customer needs Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems Experience building for enterprise requirements such as SSO, role-based access control, audit logging, data residency or compliance Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions Bonus if you’ve: Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before Led zero-to-one product development Worked in a forward deployed, solutions, or partner engineering role Worked in a founding or early startup environment Our Tech Stack Backend: Golang & Rust Frontend: React, Typescript Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more How we hire Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team. title: Technical Programme Manager, Security Engineering (Risk)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2><strong>The deadline for applying to this role is Wednesday 25th November 2026, end of day (UK Time).</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As the models we test get more capable and the environments we run them in get more sensitive, we have to continue to be able to run evaluations of highly capable models under proper control and ensure that it remains governed well. Building that governance and keeping it fast is what lets AISI keep pace with the work in front of it.<br><br>The Security Engineering team keeps AISI's research platform, evaluation environments, and sensitive data secure, and runs the governance, risk, and compliance around them. We harden the environments evaluations run in, detect and respond to threats, and build the controls that let evaluations of highly capable models proceed safely. We work with research teams across AISI, with partners in frontier AI companies and government.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Rigorous safety governance and fast-moving research aren't mutually exclusive. AISI research involves working with highly capable AI models, often before they have been released to the public and often with lowered safeguards, to understand their true capabilities. That work has to be properly controlled, and someone has to build the processes and systems that help us make the call that it's safe to run without becoming a bottleneck. We're hiring a Technical Programme Manager in Security Engineering to own the AISI-wide governance mechanism that oversees these safety judgements, the controls research teams work under, and every edge case and escalation in between. You'll work with the team's engineers and the researchers whose work this governs.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll own:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>AISI-wide Governance Mechanism that oversees safety. </strong>Own the process, make clear what it approves and how, help people work through their requirements proactively, and keep decisions well-evidenced and moving.</li> <li><strong>The research/control interface. </strong>You'll own how research teams meet the security controls that apply to their work, and the defined path for handling the exceptions.</li> <li><strong>Programme architecture and delivery. </strong>You'll track the team's work and spot problems early, with enough visibility to stay in control.</li> <li><strong>Cross-government governance engagement. </strong>You'll represent AISI on governance and risk with partners across government, including the Cabinet Office, building the relationships, and turning departmental policy into AISI process.<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who we're looking for</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential experience:</strong></h3> <p>You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes:</p> <ul> <li><strong>A track record with technical colleagues. </strong>You've delivered technical programmes somewhere similarly ambiguous. You can scope and structure an open-ended goal. Technical teams trust you.</li> <li><strong>Comfort at the frontier of AI. </strong>You don't have to be an ML researcher, but you need to hold your own in constant conversation with technical staff about the work, the strategy, and the risks. You should have a view on what's hard, what's speculative, what's blocked, and what "good" looks like.</li> <li><strong>High agency and ownership.</strong> You own outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>Strong prioritisation under pressure. </strong>You can tell what actually matters day to day and quarter to quarter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></h3> <p>Strong candidates may also have:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in security, risk, or GRC. A technical background with a genuine interest in security is ideal but not required.</li> <li>Fluency in, or appetite for, modern productivity tools (coding agents, Linear, Slack) and AI tools as part of daily work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. We care more about what you've broken, and how, than about certifications or job titles. </strong></p> <h2><strong>Selection process </strong></h2> <p>The interview process may vary from vacancy to vacancy, however, you should expect a typical process to include some technical proficiency tests, discussions with a cross-section of our team at AISI (including non-technical staff) and conversations with your team lead. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><h4> </h4> <h3><strong>Note: </strong>We are currently recruiting for multiple positions, however please only apply for the role that best aligns with your skillset and career goals.</h3> <h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Field Engineering, you are an experienced problem solver and technical leader who stays anchored to impact. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, lead technical initiatives, and excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to embed cutting-edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.</p> <p>You’ve shipped ML systems end-to-end and at scale: you design, build and test reliable, scalable ML data pipelines; you know how to explore and manipulate 3D point-cloud and mesh data to enable geometry-aware modelling; you select the right libraries, frameworks and tools and make pragmatic product decisions that set Field Engineering up for success. Working at the intersection of data science and software engineering, you translate R&D and project outputs into reusable libraries, tooling and products.</p> <p>With at least 3 years industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you're ready to not only execute but also lead and mentor others. You're truly excited about taking ownership of complex work streams and guiding teams to success, while continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.</p> <p> </p> <h2>This Role </h2> <p>As a Senior MLE, you'll work closely with our Data Scientists, Simulation Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving. You will iterate with customers and use your influence to drive decisions around reliable deployment with measurable outcomes.</p> <p>You'll:</p> <ul> <li>Own the deployment of ML models and engineering surrogates (e.g., deep learning on CAE/CFD/FEA data, time‑series forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization & control) to customer production environments.</li> <li>Communicate results and trade‑offs to senior stakeholders; steer roadmaps and influence product direction with evidence.</li> <li>Lead scoping and architecture design for data/ML systems; define success metrics, delivery plans and quality bars.</li> <li>Excel at building robust and scalable ML systems, training and inference pipelines and APIs, running both on cloud and on-prem environments. The tech stack you will use for this includes: Python, PyTorch, Pandas, fastAPI, Scipy, Kubeflow, among others.</li> <li>Mentor and develop engineers and data scientists; provide technical direction and clear, calm decision‑making under pressure.</li> <li>Travel to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, for an <strong>average of 3-4 weeks per quarter</strong>, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on-site.</li> <li>Own the scoping of new projects and work-streams with existing customers and taking part in bringing new customers to PhysicsX.</li> </ul> <p>As a senior member of the team, you’ll significantly influence our technical direction and will be involved in shaping future solutions and products, while developing your skills as a technical leader.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Our Field Engineering teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - <a href="https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world">read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!</a></strong><a href="https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world"> </a></h2> <p>We operate on a hybrid working model with 3 days in our Shoreditch office. </p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <p><strong>Build what actually matters</strong></p> <p>Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.</p> <p><strong>Learn alongside exceptional people</strong></p> <p>Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.</p> <p><strong>Influence over hierarchy</strong></p> <p>We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.</p> <p><strong>Sustainable pace, long-term ambition</strong></p> <p>Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our Shoreditch office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.</p> <p><strong>And it doesn’t stop there …</strong></p> <p>🚀 <strong>Equity options</strong> - share meaningfully in the company you’re helping to build.</p> <p>🏦 <strong>10% employer pension contribution</strong> - because investing in future matters.</p> <p>🍽️ <strong>Free office lunches</strong> - to keep you energised and focused.</p> <p>👶 <strong>Enhanced parental leave</strong> - 3 months full pay paternity and 6
