description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior Garment Technologist</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Garment Technologist</strong> to join the founding team of Quince’s new London Design Atelier. In this role, you will own the technical execution, fit, construction, and consistency of ready-to-wear products across Women’s and Men’s, partnering closely with Design, Pattern Cutting, Product Development, Sourcing, Quality, and external manufacturing partners.</p> <p>This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of creative design and product execution. You will translate design intent into technically sound, production-ready garments, leading fittings, developing fit blocks and technical standards, and solving construction and pattern challenges throughout the development process.</p> <p>Success in this role means making fit, construction, and quality a competitive advantage for Quince — improving product consistency and customer satisfaction initial prototype through production approval across Women’s and Men’s RTW.</li> <li>Partner closely with Design and Pattern Cutting to translate creative concepts into technically feasible, balance, construction, finishing, and overall fit, recommending technical solutions where needed.</li> <li>Develop, maintain, and evolve fit blocks, grading standards, and technical standards across key product categories.</li> <li>Create and maintain accurate technical specifications, measurements, construction details, and fit documentation.</li> <li>Review patterns and recommend pattern amendments to resolve fit, construction, and production issues.</li> <li>Partner with Product Development, Sourcing, and Quality to ensure products meet Quince standards for fit, construction, and vendors to ensure technical standards are consistently understood and executed.</li> <li>Leverage digital and 3D development tools where appropriate to accelerate fittings, development, and decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in garment technology, technical design, product engineering, or a closely related technical apparel role.</li> <li>Strong multi-product RTW experience, ideally across both Women’s and Men’s.</li> <li>Deep technical knowledge of garment construction, pattern cutting and amendments, grading, fit, fabrics, and production requirements.</li> <li>Strong experience with tailoring and structured product, with the ability to technically assess complex garments.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience owning the fit and technical development process from prototype through production approval.</li> <li>Highly skilled in conducting fittings and translating observations into precise, actionable technical and pattern corrections.</li> <li>Strong understanding of technical specifications, measurements, tolerances, construction methods, and production standards.</li> <li>Experience partnering directly with designers, pattern cutters, product developers, sourcing teams, factories, and vendors.</li> <li>Strong product judgment with an exceptional eye for fit, proportion, construction, and detail.</li> <li>Comfortable using customer and product performance data to inform technical decisions and prioritize improvements.</li> <li>Highly hands-on, solutions-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.</li> <li>Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple products and development timelines simultaneously.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience within a premium, luxury, or highly design-led fashion environment.</li> <li>Deep expertise in title: Developer Experience Engineer - AI SDLC
description: We Are Sparta Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders. Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has. We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market. At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done. Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies. The role You lead how Sparta builds software in the AI era. You own our AI-native software development lifecycle: the development agents engineers work alongside, the CI/CD that ships their code, and the testing strategy that lets us move fast without breaking trading workflows. AI has changed how code gets written, reviewed, and tested, and the tooling has not caught up. Your job is to make an engineer with Claude Code, a good harness and a fast pipeline several times more effective, and to prove it with data, not anecdotes. What you will do Own the AI development toolchain. Set up and evolve Claude Code and other development agents across engineering: shared skills, MCP servers, repo context, and guardrails, so agents work well in our codebase out of the box. Build agents into the lifecycle. Automate the work around the code: AI-assisted code review, test generation, dependency upgrades, migrations and incident triage, with humans in the loop where it matters. Make CI/CD fast and boring. Own build, test and release pipelines across the Nx monorepo: caching, affected-only builds, preview environments and safe, frequent deploys to AWS. Build the guardrails for everyone who builds. Anyone can build now, including product, design, data and domain experts working with agents. Create the tooling that makes it safe for them to contribute code: automated quality gates, code ownership and review rules, preview environments, policy checks and agent evals in the pipeline, so good changes ship fast and risky ones are caught early. Testing strategy sits inside this: define what we test at each level and make the right tests cheap to write. Keep it secure. Secrets, permissions and sandboxing for agents that read code and run commands, and supply-chain checks in the pipeline. Raise the bar for everyone. Run enablement, write the playbooks, pair with teams and turn good practice from one team into the default for all of engineering. What you bring Extensive experience as a hands-on software engineer, with recent focus on developer experience, platform or build and release engineering. You have rolled out AI coding tools to a team and made them stick: you know where agents help, where they fail and how to set them up for a real codebase. You lead without needing authority: you treat engineers as customers, listen first, and win adoption with tools people want to use. Nice to have Built Claude Code skills, plugins or MCP servers, or extended another agent harness. Deep CI/CD experience: you have designed pipelines for a monorepo, cut build and test times, and run safe, frequent releases. Infrastructure as code and container platforms. Experience defining or running engineering metrics. Our stack for this team Claude Ecosystem · Nx monorepo · GitHub · AWS · TypeScript · Python · Kotlin Why Join Sparta? At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded. • Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company • $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment • Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale • Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence • Top-tier tools and technology to support your success What's the Culture Like at Sparta? At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers. The Sparta Code Understanding is non-negotiable Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning. The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed. Ask for forgiveness, not for permission Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not. 90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned. Fall in love with the problem The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to. Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working. It's your fault. Lucky you. If it's on you, it's in your control. True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency. Conflict is a gift Honesty is an expression of care. Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it. Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law. title: Senior Product Manager (Used Cars)
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE OPPORTUNITY Used cars are the biggest part of the UK car market, and Carwow is going all in. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it’s bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too. We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for a vertical we are fully investing in, and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. AI changes what’s possible here. A dealer shouldn’t have to work out what a car is worth, write the advert or chase the buyer. The product should do it for them. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that looks like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to separate real dealer value from noise. If you want to build a used car marketplace where cars sell faster and buyers trust what they see, and do it with applied AI from day one, this is it. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Obsess over dealers: Spend time with dealers: visit forecourts, sit with sales teams and learn how they buy, price and sell Run your own discovery through interviews, usage data and behavioural analysis, so every decision starts from a real dealer or buyer problem Know when a dealer request would hurt buyer trust, such as thin adverts, hidden history or prices out of line with the market, and be willing to say no to the customer who pays Own the outcome and set the direction: Own used cars sold through Carwow and dealer retention in the vertical. Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. The Agentic Work Environment team The Agentic Work Environment (AWE) owns the environment everyone at Multiverse works in, wherever they are in the world. That covers the devices, workplace tools and accounts colleagues use every day, the platform our product is built and run on, and the identity and access that decide who, or which agent, can do what across all of it. Product teams own what they build; we own the ground it stands on, the path it takes to production, and the baseline standards it meets on the way. Our mission is to make the safe way the fast way for every colleague and the agents they put to work. For a security-minded AI engineer, that remit runs in two directions. In the product platform, you build security into the path itself: review agents that check every change against our baseline standards, one identity for customers, staff and agents, and detection and response through our SIEM and SOAR, so nobody, person or agent, has to remember to be secure. What your day-to-day will look like Every day will be different, but you can expect it to include: Build security into the path to production. Staying on the path should meet the security requirements without any extra work. Secure the agents we and our colleagues build. You threat-model agent systems end to end, from prompt injection and tool misuse to data leaking through context and retrieval, and design the controls that stop it: scoped tool permissions, permission-aware retrieval, sandboxing, and human approval where the risk calls for it. Give every agent an identity. You build the identity and access layer for agents. Each one has its own identity, a named owner, least-privilege access that is reviewed and can be revoked at once, and a full record of what it did. Build detection and response with agents. You write detections and automated responses on our SIEM and SOAR, and build agents that triage alerts, gather context and carry out bounded, reversible responses, so people spend their time on the cases that need judgement. Secure the workplace, worldwide. You apply the same approach to the devices, workplace tools and accounts colleagues use every day: automated controls rather than manual checklists, and access that is granted and removed as people join, move and leave. Prove it holds with security evals. You build eval pipelines and red-team exercises that show whether our agents and controls stand up to attack, and produce compliance evidence as a by-product of the work rather than as screenshots for an auditor. Influence technical direction. You have opinions about how things should be built, and you back them up with evidence. You contribute to architectural decisions, push back when the team is heading in the wrong direction, and propose better approaches. Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere. title: Software Engineer - Distributed Compute
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is one of the top algorithmic trading companies in the world. Our research cluster is the backbone of our success; it’s where all of our trading strategies are generated.</p> <p>We use a large, customized research environment with highly advanced CPU and GPU compute, storage, and networking technology. Our team thinks about the entire software stack, from the user-level API to optimizing performance out of low-level caching. We deal with everything from the theoretical, like fair resource scheduling, to the concrete, like optimizing a trader’s new program run-time performance. </p> <p>As a distributed compute engineer in a user-facing environment, you’ll develop and improve on technical solutions that make research as easy and efficient as possible. You’ll work everyday with both talented quantitative traders and software engineers across all trading teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure HRT’s research environment is best in class, with a focus on user workloads</li> <ul> <li>Maintain and improve resource scheduling, data caching, and job monitoring to make research as easy, fast, and efficient as possible, using both in-house and open source solutions</li> <li>Optimize workloads at the user level to speed up user iteration speed</li> <li>Tune workloads at the infrastructure level to make them more resource-efficient</li> <li>Share metrics and real-time information with users to give insight into workload behavior</li> <li>Sit down with users to understand their specific technical needs</li> </ul> <li>Contribute individually and through leadership and coordination of the above</li> <li>Set technical direction for the platform and take holistic ownership of the software infrastructure that supports Algo research</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Strong C++ expertise (daily use preferred)</li> <li>Python familiarity preferred</li> <li>Experience collaborating closely with quantitative researchers and traders to understand their needs</li> <li>Great communication capabilities</li> <li>Superior design, debugging, and problem solving skills</li> <li>Knowledge of UNIX operating systems (we use Linux), system/processor performance, and network communication</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). title: Software Engineer – C++
description:
<p>At Hudson River Trading (HRT), C++ is at the center of our live trading systems and research infrastructure. Our C++ engineers build the highly performant, fault-tolerant systems that power trading across global markets. HRT’s distributed system is on the Pareto frontier of latency and throughput, giving you limitless opportunity to leverage your deep knowledge of C++, OS internals, CPU architecture, and networking hardware and protocols. You’ll work side-by-side with researchers, traders, and hardware specialists, implementing solutions where every microsecond matters.</p> <p>Our bottom-up approach to projects and our highly collaborative environment empower talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. title: Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>We are seeking highly motivated and skilled <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research Engineers</span> who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.  </p> <p>Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. title: Enterprise Sales Leader
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to build one of n8n’s most predictable Enterprise sales teams. You’ll develop high-performing Enterprise AEs, instill forecast and pipeline discipline, and create a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals. To make that happen, you’ll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win: DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE TEAM Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews, raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance. Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes your numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics. Create a repeatable operating model with clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms, so execution doesn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal. Hire, onboard, and scale the team quickly, establishing career paths and succession plans as we grow. SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR YOUR TERRITORY Prioritize and run your Enterprise territory with focus, balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong. Set the strategy for the team’s most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen. Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical and business wins. BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution. Orchestrate executive engagement across your accounts, aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals. Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy. PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: You have 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals. 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: You have deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record of coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection. 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: You’ve run a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive. 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals. 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes. 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback. 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum. 🇬🇧 Location: You're based in the UK, Ireland or a European country where we hire (not France, Italy, Sweden, Switzerland or Romania), and happy to travel regularly to meet clients across the Nordics, Benelux, the Middle East and Africa. 🇬🇧 English: You’re a native or bilingual speaker of English. 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: You have experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions. 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion. Nice-to-haves Additional languages: You're fluent in a regional language (e.g. Dutch, Arabic, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish). 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: You’ve worked in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories. 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving, and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down. 📊 Operational excellence: You have strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution. Why join us? You’ll take a team of Enterprise AEs and turn it into a repeatable engine, in one of the fastest-growing open-source companies in Europe. The playbooks you build and the people you hire will shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest technical organizations. You’ll work directly with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product, so your voice carries well beyond your own team. n8n is a remote-first company with a passionate community of builders, a culture of autonomy and experimentation, and a very high bar for talent. If you want to build something that lasts while the company scales, apply now and help us make n8n the default way enterprises automate. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. Supporting approximately 150 employees in London, alongside remote colleagues across the UK, Europe and parts of APAC, you'll be our primary onsite IT specialist, ensuring our people, systems and workplace technology run smoothly. Technical Independence & Troubleshooting: Proven ability to independently diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system and connectivity issues across Windows and macOS. Comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems and knowing when to escalate appropriately. description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><img style="max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-3-8.png" alt="" width="1001"><strong><br><br></strong></span></p> <p>Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.</p> <p>We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. </p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>Millions of people visit the Rightmove website every month. We have a huge amount of data about how people use the site, and what this means to our customers. You’ll be at the centre of our analytics platform to help drive this, modelling and productionising high‑quality data assets in DBT on BigQuery, and maintaining the semantic layer to power the insights that will impact millions of users.<br><br>Working closely with a highly collaborative and high-performing team of data engineers, analysts, and product teams, you will help standardise metrics, elevate data quality, and enable self‑serve analytics so teams can move faster and smarter to drive real business impact.<br><br>Ultimately, this role would suit an analytics engineer who’s ready to take ownership of building high-quality, well-documented data models, contribute to the development of a scalable analytics layer of a modern data stack, and help shape how data is used across the UK’s favourite property site.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong><br>- Model, build, and productionise robust data assets using dbt and BigQuery<br>- Maintain and evolve the semantic layer in Looker to support consistent, self-serve analytics<br>- Ensure data is transformed, tested, and of high quality before consumption by downstream users<br>- Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand requirements and deliver trusted data models<br>- Document and expose data assets in a way that is easy to understand and use<br>- Apply and advocate engineering best practices across analytics codebases<br>- Maintain the data catalogue and support a single source of truth for analytics<br>- Analyse workflows and collaborate with data engineers to improve performance and maintainability<br>- Be proactive in identifying opportunities to reduce complexity and cost across the data platform<br>- Participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives</p> <p><br><strong>We're Looking for Someone Who</strong><br>- Has 3–5 years of proven experience in analytics engineering or data modelling, working on production-grade data models and semantic layers within a large-scale, cloud-based data platform<br>- Has hands-on experience with dbt and understands modular data modelling best practices<br>- Is confident writing and optimising complex SQL queries in BigQuery (or Redshift/Snowflake)<br>- Has experience working with Looker (Core) and maintaining semantic layers (LookML)<br>- Has worked in a production environment where data models are used to power business-critical reporting and dashboards<br>- Understands the importance of documentation, testing, and version control (Git) in analytics workflows<br>- Has experience working in a cloud-native environment - GCP highly preferred, also AWS<br>- Optimistic, curious and gets excited by tech, enjoys keeping up with current trends. Actively gets involved and enjoys contributing to tech events<br>- Is proactive, communicative, and comfortable contributing to technical discussions and design decisions<br>- Brings a collaborative and curious mindset, and enjoys working in cross-functional teams</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><strong>Life at Rightmove</strong></span></h3> <p>Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>We create value…</strong>by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.</li> <li><strong>We think bigger…</strong>by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.</li> <li><strong>We care deeply…</strong>by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.</li> <li><strong>We move together…</strong>by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.</li> <li><strong>We make a difference…</strong>by focusing on delivering measurable impact.</li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><code><a href="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/culture/" target="_blank"><img style="float: left; max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Job-alerts-1.png" alt="" width="452"></a></code></p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"> </p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"> </p> <p>We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with <strong>89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work</strong>, we’re clearly doing something right!<strong> <br><br><img src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/07/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-1-2.png" alt="" width="1000" style="max-width: 100%;"><br></strong></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><strong><img style="max-width: 100%;">What we offer</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.</li> <li>27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.</li> <li>Contributory stakeholder pension.</li> <li>Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.</li> <li>Competitive compensation package.</li> <li>Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.</li> <li>Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.</li> <li>Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.</li> <li>Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.</li> <li>We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 222, 180);"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-8.png" alt="" width="1000"></span></strong></p> <hr> <h4><em>As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. <br></em><br><em>At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.</em></h4> <hr> <h4>By applying, you confirm that you are aged at least 18 or over and that you’ve read and understood our <a class="decorated-link" href="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/c/privacy-policy/" target="_blank" data-start="192" data-end="259"><strong data-start="193" data-end="211">Privacy Policy</strong></a>, which explains how we handle and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.</h4></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Total Rewards Partner
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. Senior Total Rewards Partner, Total Rewards How you'll make impact As Airwallex scales globally and prepares for its next stage of growth, you’ll own and evolve the Total Rewards agenda across compensation, benefits, job architecture, benchmarking, equity governance and pay transparency. Own and evolve global compensation frameworks, salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, compensation cycles and financial models that support hiring, retention, executive decision-making and international expansion. Build and improve job architecture and leveling frameworks that support organisational scalability, internal equity and talent mobility. Shape regional and global benefits programmes, including plan design, annual renewals, broker and insurer negotiations, benchmarking and cost optimisation, while balancing employee value, fiscal discipline and local market requirements. Hands-on benefits administration isn’t the primary focus of this role. Partner with executive leadership, People Partners and Talent Acquisition to turn complex reward data into clear recommendations, challenge decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data or regulatory requirements, and lead Total Rewards initiatives from scoping and design through implementation. Support international market expansion by developing competitive, compliant and locally relevant compensation and benefits frameworks across global markets. What we're looking for Essentials 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, ideally within high-growth technology or fintech environments. Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling global compensation frameworks, benefits programs, and equity structures in hyper-growth organisations. Strong expertise in compensation strategy, including market benchmarking, job and salary architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, and financial modelling. Experience designing benefits programs and leading annual renewals, including broker and insurer negotiations. Hands-on benefits administration is not a primary focus. Practical experience managing compensation planning and equity programs, leading system implementations or migrations, and working with HR technology platforms such as Workday, BambooHR, Carta, Shareworks or Pave. Advanced analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data and financial models into actionable insights and executive recommendations. Proven ability to influence and communicate Total Rewards decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, and Talent Acquisition, demonstrating sound business judgement and confidence in challenging decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data, or regulatory requirements. A builder mindset, with the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and develop scalable solutions across global markets and time zones. Preferred Experience in a late-stage private, pre-IPO, or recently listed company, particularly navigating equity program transformation, strengthening rewards governance, and preparing for public-market readiness. Experience building scalable Total Rewards programs from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with end-to-end ownership and strong accountability. Experience advising C-suite and senior leadership stakeholders on compensation, benefits, equity and rewards governance. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, including scenario modelling and assessment of financial implications. Experience partnering effectively across diverse cultures, functions and international teams, navigating time zones and varying local market requirements. Experience translating complex compensation, benefits and equity concepts into clear, actionable messages for business leaders, People teams and employees. You'll thrive here if You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. Learn more about your team People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. Our company is growing fast across multiple regions, hiring in highly competitive markets, while many of the systems and programs themselves are still being designed. That means the job is not to run established processes well — it is to define what great looks like for a global fintech at this stage of growth, and then build it. This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Manager, Enterprise
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact You'll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and grow gross profit through renewals, upsell and expansion across Airwallex's product suite. You'll build trusted relationships with senior commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, using strategic account plans, business reviews and customer insight to increase adoption, improve retention and identify new growth opportunities. Grow existing customer accounts through renewals, upsell and expansion across Airwallex's product suite. Build and execute strategic account plans that clarify customer objectives, stakeholder relationships, risks, renewal priorities and future growth opportunities. Lead commercial negotiations, business reviews and cross-sell opportunities that demonstrate value, improve retention and support Net Revenue Retention. Coordinate complex onboarding, escalations and customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams. Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts while turning customer feedback into product, operational and go-to-market improvements. You'll work from our London office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships. A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions. Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders. Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally. Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives. Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage. Preferred Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products. Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders. You’ll combine strategic leadership with hands-on commercial execution. One day, you might be reviewing regional P&L performance and reallocating budgets across markets; the next, coaching a Country Manager on acquisition strategy, evaluating a new market opportunity, negotiating a strategic partnership or addressing a market that is falling behind its growth targets. You will establish a high-performance operating cadence across the region, using data and commercial insight to identify opportunities, address underperformance, share best practices and allocate resources where they can generate the greatest impact. You will work closely with product, marketing, operations, compliance and finance to ensure that regional plans are supported by the right capabilities and executed effectively. Build their capabilities in budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, channel investment and profitability, while maintaining appropriate regional oversight and alignment. Regional growth strategy and planning. Own the regional growth strategy and oversee the development and execution of annual business plans, quarterly growth plans and monthly operating plans across all markets. Ensure plans are grounded in market opportunity, clear performance targets, realistic budgets and measurable initiatives. Review progress regularly and adjust priorities as needed. Performance management and operating cadence. Establish a consistent rhythm of business reviews across the region, including monthly performance reviews, quarterly planning and regular growth and budget calibration sessions. Track performance against targets, identify risks and opportunities early, and ensure every market has clear actions to address underperformance. Budget allocation and resource optimisation. Oversee regional marketing and growth budgets, ensuring investment is allocated to markets and channels with the strongest potential returns. Identify forecast underspend, evaluate opportunities to accelerate growth and reallocate resources where appropriate to maximise regional impact and new-user acquisition. Market expansion and new-country launches. Identify and evaluate opportunities to expand into new Asian markets. Develop market-entry strategies, assess commercial potential, define investment requirements and coordinate launch plans across product, marketing, operations, compliance and finance. Establish clear launch milestones and ensure new markets have the leadership, infrastructure and commercial plans needed to scale. Customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness. Supervise country-level acquisition strategies across paid and organic channels, partnerships, referrals, community networks and other distribution opportunities. Ensure teams optimise against measurable outcomes, including new users, customer acquisition cost, conversion, transfer volume, retention and lifetime value. Encourage experimentation and the adoption of successful approaches across markets. Strategic partnerships and distribution. Guide Country Managers in identifying, negotiating and developing strategic partnerships that accelerate acquisition and transaction growth. Support high-value regional partnerships where relevant, establish effective commercial frameworks and ensure partnerships translate into measurable business results. Pricing, unit economics and profitability. Oversee market-level pricing strategies and unit economics, ensuring each country balances competitive customer propositions with sustainable margins. Challenge investment decisions, review corridor and channel profitability, and help teams identify opportunities to improve contribution and long-term commercial performance. Market intelligence and competitive strategy. Maintain a strong understanding of customer behaviours, diaspora communities, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations and market-specific opportunities across Asia. Translate market insights into regional priorities and ensure Country Managers adapt their strategies to local customer needs. Cross-functional leadership. Partner with product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other central teams to align regional priorities with company-wide objectives. Represent the needs of Asian markets in central planning and ensure teams have the capabilities, resources and support required to execute their growth plans. Leadership development and organisational effectiveness. Build a strong regional leadership team by developing Country Managers into commercially capable, accountable business owners. Establish clear decision-making frameworks, encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across markets, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency and continuous improvement. Executive reporting and strategic decision-making. Provide clear, data-led updates on regional performance, financial forecasts, growth opportunities, key risks and resource requirements. Present recommendations to senior leadership and drive decisions that support LemFi's long-term growth and profitability. Your experience An experienced regional commercial leader: 10–15 years of experience across fintech, payments, remittances, financial services or high-growth businesses, with a track record of managing substantial commercial targets and preferably multi-market P&L responsibility. A proven people leader: Experience managing senior market leaders, Country Managers or commercial teams across multiple geographies. You know how to set direction, coach leaders, build accountability and create high-performing teams. Strong P&L ownership: Demonstrated experience managing revenue, costs, budgets, forecasts and profitability. You can connect country-level commercial decisions to overall regional financial performance. A strategic growth operator: Experience developing and overseeing annual strategies, quarterly plans and monthly execution priorities. You can translate business objectives into clear plans, measurable targets and consistent delivery. Commercially and analytically sharp: Strong understanding of customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, conversion, gross profit, retention, unit economics and channel performance. You use data to challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and make resource-allocation decisions. Experienced in market expansion: A track record of launching, scaling or entering new markets, assessing commercial potential and coordinating cross-functional execution in complex environments. Strong budget and investment management: Experience overseeing multi-market budgets, identifying performance gaps, reallocating investment and balancing growth ambitions with financial discipline. A partnership and distribution builder: Experience developing strategic commercial relationships, negotiating agreements and building acquisition channels that deliver measurable growth. Hands-on and execution-focused: Comfortable moving between regional strategy, financial reviews, leadership coaching and operational problem-solving. You act decisively, take ownership and thrive in a fast-moving environment. A strong cross-functional collaborator: Able to align product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other teams around shared priorities while balancing regional requirements with company-wide objectives. Adaptable across diverse markets: Comfortable operating across different customer segments, cultures, competitive environments and levels of market maturity. Experience across Asian markets or diaspora-focused businesses is an advantage. An accountable and empowering leader: You establish high standards while giving capable teams the autonomy to make decisions. You know when to coach, when to challenge and when to intervene to protect business performance. Nice to have Remittance and payments experience: Experience scaling international money transfers, cross-border payments or digital wallets, with a strong understanding of FX pricing, corridor economics and customer behaviour. Experience across Asian markets: Existing knowledge of one or more of China, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh or the Philippines, including relevant customer segments, competitive dynamics and commercial opportunities. Multi-country P&L experience: Previous responsibility for a regional business spanning multiple markets, with a demonstrated ability to balance local market ownership and regional financial objectives. Market launch experience: Experience taking new markets from initial opportunity assessment through launch and into sustainable growth. Diaspora and distribution networks: Relationships with relevant community organisations, student associations, employers, influencers and other distribution partners across key sending and receiving markets. Why join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. The role Forward Deployed Energy Engineers are a new role at Watershed, combining energy and advisory expertise with product-building skills and commercial instinct. You’ll operate at the cutting edge with Watershed customers to build and deploy the next generation of enterprise energy management. Energy is one of the largest costs on a big company’s P&L and one of its largest sources of emissions. Watershed is building the product that changes that, and it’s the company’s biggest bet for its next chapter. Now we’re building energy management from zero to one, with engagements underway with a small group of customers today and scaling in 2027. Starting from the energy data already in Watershed, you’ll find where they’re overspending, deliver the savings, prototype with AI what should become product, and help customers implement solutions, including buying clean power. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</p> <p>Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
