title: Senior Director, ML Software
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Set the direction for Graphcore’s ML software, with accountability for organisational leadership, investment priorities and delivery across platform generations. As Senior Director of ML Software in Bristol, you’ll report to the VP of Software. Your organisation delivers the machine learning software and analysis tools that enable AI models to run on Graphcore’s platform. You’ll translate business objectives into multi year roadmaps, aligning resources, investment and delivery commitments. You’ll own outcomes from early platform bring-up through production release and support. Your remit spans machine learning frameworks, kernel libraries, hardware simulation, networking software, profiling and debugging tools. You’ll lead through senior engineering leaders, shape organisational structure and develop successors. Beyond your function, you’ll shape wider software priorities, influence executive decisions and sponsor initiatives across the organisation. </p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>You’ll partner with silicon, hardware, architecture, system software, product and operations leaders to align roadmaps and resolve integration risks. With architecture leaders, you’ll challenge design assumptions across frameworks, simulation, collectives and tooling. Your leadership team will own achievable, adequately resourced plans, with clear expectations for milestones, quality and outcomes. You’ll resolve risks promptly, make portfolio trade-offs and escalate decisions requiring executive alignment. Delivery and quality measures will guide investment in continuous integration, automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, regression coverage and release governance. You’ll turn incidents into lasting improvements, with reliability, security and testability treated as engineering outcomes. </p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Organisational leadership:</strong> You’ve led sizeable system software organisations through managers and senior technical leaders, accountable for complex, multi-team hardware and software programmes. You set clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for delivery, quality and business outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Building leadership capacity:</strong> You’ve scaled engineering organisations, shaped structures and workforce plans, and led performance management and organisational change. You coach senior leaders, develop successors and build the capabilities needed to meet changing product and business priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategy and investment:</strong> You’ve owned multi-year roadmaps and delivery portfolios, aligning investment, capacity and commitments with business objectives. You make portfolio-level trade-offs under resource constraints, resolve critical technical dependencies and manage risks across competing programmes.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering quality and governance:</strong> You’ve set organisation-wide quality and release standards, supported by hardware-based automation, regression coverage and robust validation. You use delivery and quality measures, incident learning and risk governance to drive improvements across teams.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Executive influence:</strong> You’ve aligned senior stakeholders across organisational boundaries, resolved complex decisions and communicated strategic risks and investment choices. You translate technical trade-offs into implications for products, customers, operational resilience and business outcomes, contributing beyond your immediate function.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategic and technical judgement:</strong> You balance delivery commitments and business outcomes with reliability, security, maintainability and long-term platform needs. Experience with machine learning software, hardware-software interfaces, AI accelerators, GPUs or high-performance computing would be valuable. </p> </li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong> Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong> Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong> Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong> Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong> Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong> Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong> Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3>Sponsorship</h3> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. </p> <p><strong>Access to controlled technology</strong></p> <p>Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process. </p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. </p> <p>Ready to set Graphcore’s ML software direction and build the leadership team to deliver it? Apply now.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Platform Engineer, Infrastructure - Core UK & Ireland
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <p>Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.</p> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a <strong>Staff Platform Engineer</strong> to join our Platform Engineering team based in the UK or Ireland. This position plays a critical role within the EMEA Platform Engineering organisation, partnering closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and United States to build and operate the platforms that power Fanatics Betting & Gaming’s global software ecosystem.<br><br>As a Staff Engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, leading complex technical initiatives across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will influence platform architecture, define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help drive technical design and delivery of core platform capabilities spanning cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, Observability, CI/CD systems, and developer tooling</li> <li>Architect, build, and operate cloud-native platforms on AWS with a focus on reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency</li> <li>Lead the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows.</li> <li>Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity</li> <li>Continue to drive Infrastructure as Code and automation practices across teams</li> <li>Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs</li> <li>Participate in and/or lead complex, cross-team initiatives and provide technical clarity in ambiguous problem spaces</li> <li>Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and participate in on-call rotations</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering</li> <li>Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Ability to influence without authority and communicate effectively across regions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or portals</li> <li>FinOps or cloud cost management experience</li> <li>Regulated or high-availability environment experience</li> <li>Backend development experience</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery.</p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong> just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?</p> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why HRtechX</strong></h2> <p>HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.</p> <p>HRtechX is part of United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.</li> <li>Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency</li> <li>Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do</li> <li>Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do</li> <li>A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people</li> <li>Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Practical details</strong></h2> <p>Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Product Manager
description: About ExTrac ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight. Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai . The Role We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on. ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with. What the job involves Roadmap ownership Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan. Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning. Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked. Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions. Discovery and definition Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs. Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility. Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve. Product operations and delivery Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow. Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments. Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan. Technical and data judgement Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics. Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders. Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction. Research, validation and data Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it. Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want. Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users. Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design. For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off. Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation. Working with AI: Co-Analyst Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need. Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses. Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations. Raising the bar for product practice Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use. Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas. Act as a coaching and advisory resource for colleagues, sharing product craft across teams and mentoring less experienced team members as the function grows. Cross-functional collaboration Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, machine learning, design, customer success, and research within your product areas, ensuring cohesive development cycles and smooth delivery. Partner closely with the design team on design and UX, engineering on build and AI/ML, and the research and analysis team on domain expertise, synthesising their input into coherent product decisions. Facilitate cross-team workshops to bring evidence and expertise together, and strengthen pre-sprint and in-sprint communication. You should apply if You have shipped complex products in technical domains, ideally AI/ML, data, or intelligence, and you do your best work owning a product area end to end: from opportunity definition to shipped customer value. You are as comfortable in the detail as in the plan. Writing a PRD, interrogating usage data, or pressure-testing a model integration with engineers is the core of your craft, not a chore. You hold evidence and conviction in balance. You know when user research should lead and when expertise-led judgement should, and you can make and defend either call. You do your best work in a founder-led, vision-led company. You know the difference between owning a vision and making a vision real, and the second is the work you enjoy. The pace and ambiguity of a growth-stage company is what you are looking for rather than what you are tolerating. You find genuine satisfaction in bringing order to messy tooling and processes, because you have seen how much leverage a well-run product operation creates. You make the people around you better. You share your craft, coach colleagues, and improve the processes you work within, without needing a title that says you must. Where this role can take you Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means broader ownership, higher-stakes bets, and more direct influence over product strategy. Help define how AI-native intelligence products get built. Co-Analyst is a category-shaping product, and the work you deliver will influence how the industry approaches human-AI analytical workflows. Grow with the Product function. As ExTrac scales, this role is the natural path towards senior product leadership. Progress on either track: ExTrac values the individual contributor and Manager paths equally, so you can deepen technical scope or take on people leadership as your responsibilities grow. Requirements ExTrac provides services to a number of government clients, some of which specify nationality criteria for individuals seeking security clearance. For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand. 4+ years in product management, ideally in AI/ML, data science, or intelligence-related fields, with a proven track record of shipping complex products from concept through to delivery. Experience delivering product work in a startup or growth-stage company, with demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end with minimal oversight. Able to translate complex technical solutions into product decisions, judging when user research should lead (usability and workflow fit) and when expertise-led conviction should (what to build), and using data and analytics as inputs rather than the whole answer. Comfortable working hand in hand with engineering and ML teams, with a good understanding of how complex ML models are integrated into user-facing products, alongside data processing and analytics. Skilled at working with engineering, ML, design, and customer success, and at synthesising input from multiple disciplines into coherent product decisions in a collaborative, agile environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex information clearly to executives, clients, and internal teams. Desirable Experience in threat intelligence, risk analysis, or geopolitical intelligence, or in other highly regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g. government, defence). Experience working within complex, data-led startups or other high-growth digital environments. A foundation in machine learning, data analytics, or AI product management, particularly integrating complex ML models into user-facing products. Interview Process We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows: Initial Intro Interview - 30 Minutes Craft & Competency-based Interviews - 60 Minutes x 2 Senior Executive Interview - 45 Minutes Benefits Competitive salary based on skills and experience. A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions. Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme. A sabbatical leave offer. £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays. Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office. A role that combines mission-driven purpose with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing company. ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team. title: Commercial Strategy & Growth Lead
description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our Commercial Strategy & Growth Lead, you'll be hands-on, owning pricing, retention and marketplace growth initiatives from idea to result. Which trades should pay what, and where? Why do members churn? How do we ensure our trades get value from our product? You'll find questions like these in our data, answer them yourself and see the answer through to launch. It's a broad remit with real ownership over how we price, how we grow our member base and how we use data, experimentation and AI to run a smarter commercial operation. The job, unfiltered: Spot the opportunity yourself, size it, build the business case and work with cross-functional teams (Product, CRM, Sales, Retention) to deliver it. Run experiments to grow revenue: test pricing logic, drive upsell, and increase product attachment, then use the results to shape how our pricing model evolves. Tackle churn: look at the health of the member lifecycle, find where value is leaking (including why some members leave early) and lead the work to fix it. Work out how supply shapes revenue: understand what happens to leads, conversion and member value when a trade or area runs short of tradespeople, and recommend what we do about it. Build the tracking, benchmarking and alerting that keep our pricing sharp, using AI and automation where they genuinely help us move faster. Do the doing. You'll work across several programmes at once and move things forward with others, not just write the strategy. In your first six months, you could ship a pricing test, own a churn intervention programme or build an AI-assisted alerting tool. The fit: You find and own the work: an opportunity you spotted without being asked, sized, built the case for and saw through to a number. You’re comfortable with SQL, and turn messy datasets into clear recommendations that drive decisions and action. You've made a recommendation that a senior person acted on, and you can explain it in a few clear sentences. You think commercially about pricing, retention and member value, and the trade-offs between volume, churn and conversion. You might be coming from marketplace supply or category, strategy and operations or BizOps, consulting then industry, subscription propositions, or retail pricing and promotions. You don't need a revenue or pricing job title. This isn't the role if your work is mainly reporting or dashboards, you want to manage a team, or your experience is pipeline and CRM operations. (Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.) We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in. title: Senior Manager, Engagement
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the Role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Professional Services is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced leader to run Legora's Professional Services team, building and developing the people who own our most significant professional services relationships, and setting the standard for how those firms adopt Legora and change the way they work. This is a role for someone who has led teams through change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed, not hoped for. You will own the performance of the team and the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers: hiring and developing Engagement Managers, setting the adoption strategy they execute against, governing quality and pace, and stepping in at the senior moments that decide whether a programme lands. That portfolio includes our global relationship with one key Big 4 client, our most significant professional services partnership, delivered by the Engagement Managers in your team across its member firms. You will set the direction for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, hold the programme to account, and be the senior Legora voice in the room when it matters. You will travel when needed to support your team in market and build relationships at the most senior level. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption capability at Legora: designing the playbook the team works from, helping our clients realise measurable ROI, and scaling a function that can carry far more than it does today. What You'll Do You'll lead the Professional Services team and own the outcomes of the portfolio it delivers. Specifically, you will: Lead, hire and develop the Professional Services team: set expectations, coach Engagement Managers, run performance and development conversations, and build a bench that can scale with the business. Own the global adoption strategy for the portfolio, including our flagship Big 4 relationship, and hold the team accountable for coherent execution across regions and member firms. Define the adoption playbook the team works from: the change-management approach, stakeholder mapping, operating cadence and target outcomes that make our programmes repeatable rather than heroic. Govern delivery quality and pace: success plans, enablement, value reviews, escalation paths, and intervene where a programme is off track. Act as the senior Legora relationship owner for the most important stakeholders in the portfolio, stepping in at executive moments, QBRs and escalations while your team runs the day-to-day programme. Be accountable for adoption, retention and satisfaction across the portfolio, with clear measurable outcomes and ROI you can defend to clients and internally. Orchestrate cross-functional engagement to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end context across the portfolio. Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the portfolio. Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement. Travel internationally to support your team on the ground and build senior relationships across member firms. What You Bring You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You get satisfaction from making a team better than it was when you found it, and you're comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. We're looking for: 8+ years' professional services experience - management consulting, legal, LegalTech or enterprise customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical. At least 5 years in a people management role, with a track record of hiring, developing and retaining high-performing teams. Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable — we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms. A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations. Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes — and then making that approach repeatable across a team. A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional influence: much of what your team needs sits with Product, Engineering and GTM, and you can bring those people with you without direct authority. Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries, or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast. Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident. Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams. High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise, when to act and when to let your team run. A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it. Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process. title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - title: Tax Associate
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Tax Senior Associate,</strong> reporting to the CFO. This role covers multiple Canonical corporate entities in several countries. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>astute and forward-thinking tax professional</strong> to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the CFO, you will <strong>design and own the tax processes</strong> that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business - tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and strategic thinking</strong> over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Managing and coordinating the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings</li> <li>Working with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation</li> <li>Acting as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.</li> <li>Identifying opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation</li> <li>Managing and running tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements</li> <li>Working closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Monitoring changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting Team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting team (CIF) sits at the intersection of our Borrowing and Finance collectives, responsible for developing, executing and managing the models used to calculate IFRS 9 ECL, and credit risk capital through the annual ICAAP. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Linux Desktop Support Engineer (London UK office)
description: <p>This is an opportunity to kickstart your career by joining Canonical. You will be working from our Canonical London Office and will be accountable for delivering technical support to our employees and customers, as well as facilitating AV support for office conferences and events. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>True Ownership:</strong> Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:</strong> Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Advocacy:</strong> Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.</li> <li><strong>Operational Reliability:</strong> Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Communication Excellence:</strong> Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.</li> <li><strong>The Soft-Skill Edge:</strong> A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.</li> <li><strong>Academic Dedication:</strong> Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li><strong>On-Site Technical Leadership:</strong> Based in our state-of-the-art London, UK office, you will serve as a key technical support resource for our local teams and employees.</li> <li><strong>Driven Mindset:</strong> A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li><em>Virtualization & Cloud:</em> Using KVM or OpenStack.</li> <li><em>Containers:</em> primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.</li> <li><em>Storage Ecosystems:</em> Block, object, and network storage technologies.</li> <li><em>System Networking:</em> Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices.
